units.source_text: 再细端详，老师并不像有病痛的样子。

en.t: Looking more closely, the teacher did not seem to be suffering from any illness.

units.source_text: 不管怎么说，这种姿势令人感到是失去了自豪和威信，显得有些卑微，几乎像是兽类的睡态。

en.t: In any case, that posture gave the impression that he had lost his pride and dignity; it seemed somewhat abject, almost like the sleeping pose of an animal.

units.source_text: 我看出他的衣袖在微微地颤动，仿佛有一种无形的沉重的东西压在他的脊背上。

en.t: I could see his sleeve trembling faintly, as if some invisible, heavy thing were pressing down on his back.
